# Distributions and Bayes

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.swift from the Quiver 1.6.0 public API. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every API below exists in Quiver 1.0.0 and later unless it is tagged *(since X)*. Each entry is the declaration, then the first line of its documentation.

## Distributions

`enum Distributions` — Probability distributions exposed as a stateless namespace. *(since 1.1.0)*


## Distributions.normal

`enum normal` — Normal distribution functions. *(since 1.1.0)*

- `static func pdf(x: Double, mean: Double, standardDeviation: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the probability density of the normal distribution at `x`. Returns: The probability density at `x`, or `nil` if `standardDeviation <= 0`. *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func logPDF(x: Double, mean: Double, standardDeviation: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the natural log of the normal probability density at `x`. Returns: The natural log of the density at `x`, or `nil` if `standardDeviation <= 0`. *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func cdf(x: Double, mean: Double, standardDeviation: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the cumulative probability `P(X <= x)` under the normal distribution. Returns: The cumulative probability at `x`, or `nil` if `standardDeviation <= 0`. *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func quantile(p: Double, mean: Double, standardDeviation: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the quantile (inverse CDF) of the normal distribution at probability `p`. Returns: The quantile at `p`, or `nil` if `p` is outside `(0, 1)`, `p <= 1e-15` or `p >= 1 - 1e-15`, or `standardDeviation <= 0`. *(since 1.2.0)*

## Distributions.t

`enum t` — Student's t-distribution functions. *(since 1.2.0)*

- `static func cdf(x: Double, df: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the cumulative probability `P(T <= x)` under the t-distribution with `df` degrees of freedom. Returns: The cumulative probability at `x`, or `nil` if `df <= 0` or the computation produces a non-finite result. *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func quantile(p: Double, df: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the quantile (inverse CDF) of the t-distribution at probability `p`. Returns: The quantile at `p`, or `nil` if `p` is outside `(0, 1)`, `df <= 0`, or the computation produces a non-finite result. *(since 1.2.0)*

## Distributions.chiSquared

`enum chiSquared` — Chi-squared distribution functions. *(since 1.2.0)*

- `static func cdf(x: Double, df: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the cumulative probability `P(X² <= x)` under the chi-squared distribution with `df` degrees of freedom. Returns: The cumulative probability at `x`, or `nil` if `df <= 0` or the computation produces a non-finite result. *(since 1.2.0)*

## Distributions.poisson

`enum poisson` — Poisson distribution functions. *(since 1.2.5)*

- `static func pmf(k: Int, lambda: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the probability mass `P(K = k)` under a Poisson distribution with rate `lambda`. Returns: The probability mass at `k`, or `nil` if `k < 0` or `lambda <= 0`. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func logPMF(k: Int, lambda: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the natural log of the Poisson probability mass at `k`. Returns: The log probability mass at `k`, or `nil` if `k < 0` or `lambda <= 0`. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func cdf(k: Int, lambda: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the cumulative probability `P(K <= k)` under a Poisson distribution with rate `lambda`. Returns: The cumulative probability at `k`, or `nil` if `lambda <= 0`. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func quantile(p: Double, lambda: Double) -> Int?` — Returns the smallest integer `k` such that `P(K <= k) >= p`. Returns: The smallest `k` for which `cdf(k:lambda:) >= p`, or `nil` if `p` is outside `[0, 1]` or `lambda <= 0`. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func mean(lambda: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the mean of a Poisson distribution. Equal to the rate `lambda`. Returns: The mean, or `nil` if `lambda <= 0`. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func variance(lambda: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the variance of a Poisson distribution. Equal to the rate `lambda`. Returns: The variance, or `nil` if `lambda <= 0`. *(since 1.2.5)*

## Distributions.binomial

`enum binomial` — Binomial distribution functions. *(since 1.2.5)*

- `static func pmf(k: Int, n: Int, p: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the probability mass `P(K = k)` of seeing `k` successes in `n` independent trials. Returns: The probability mass at `k`, or `nil` if any input is out of domain. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func logPMF(k: Int, n: Int, p: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the natural log of the binomial probability mass at `k`. Returns: The log probability mass at `k`, or `nil` if any input is out of domain. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func cdf(k: Int, n: Int, p: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the cumulative probability `P(K <= k)` of at most `k` successes in `n` trials. Returns: The cumulative probability at `k`, or `nil` if any input is out of domain. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func quantile(p: Double, n: Int, probability: Double) -> Int?` — Returns the smallest integer `k` such that `P(K <= k) >= p`. Returns: The smallest `k` for which `cdf(k:n:p:) >= p`, or `nil` if any input is out of domain. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func mean(n: Int, p: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the mean of a binomial distribution. Equal to `n·p`. Returns: The mean, or `nil` if any input is out of domain. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func variance(n: Int, p: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the variance of a binomial distribution. Equal to `n·p·(1-p)`. Returns: The variance, or `nil` if any input is out of domain. *(since 1.2.5)*

## Bayes

`enum Bayes` — Bayes' theorem exposed as a stateless namespace. *(since 1.2.5)*

- `static func posterior(prior: Double, likelihood: Double, evidence: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the posterior probability of a hypothesis given evidence. Returns: The posterior probability P(H | E) in `[0, 1]`, or `nil` if any input is out of domain or the resulting posterior is not finite. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func posterior(prior: Double, trueRate: Double, falsePositiveRate: Double) -> Double?` — Returns the posterior probability of a hypothesis given a positive test. Returns: The posterior probability P(H | positive) in `[0, 1]`, or `nil` if any input is out of domain or the implied marginal P(positive) is zero. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `static func posterior(prior: BayesPrior, likelihood: BayesLikelihood) -> BayesPosterior?` — Returns the posterior distribution over a set of competing hypotheses. Returns: A `BayesPosterior` carrying the same hypothesis labels with their updated probabilities, or `nil` if the hypothesis counts do not match or every joint probability is zero. *(since 1.2.5)*

## BayesPrior

`struct BayesPrior` — A labeled prior distribution over a set of mutually exclusive hypotheses. *(since 1.2.5)*

Conforms to: Codable, Equatable.

- `let hypotheses: [String]` — The hypothesis labels, in the same order as `probabilities`. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `let probabilities: [Double]` — The prior probability of each hypothesis. Sums to `1.0 ± 1e-9`. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `init?(hypotheses: [String], probabilities: [Double])` — Creates a labeled prior, validating that the inputs are well formed. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `func markdownTable() -> String` — Returns a Markdown table of the prior distribution. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `func csvRow() -> String` — Returns a single CSV row of prior probabilities, in hypothesis order. *(since 1.2.5)*

## BayesLikelihood

`struct BayesLikelihood` — The likelihood P(E | H_i) for each hypothesis under consideration. *(since 1.2.5)*

Conforms to: Codable, Equatable.

- `let perHypothesis: [Double]` — The likelihood P(E | H_i) for each hypothesis, in matching order. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `init?(_ values: [Double])` — Creates a likelihood vector, validating that every entry is in `[0, 1]`. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `func markdownTable() -> String` — Returns a Markdown table of the per-hypothesis likelihoods. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `func csvRow() -> String` — Returns a single CSV row of likelihoods, in hypothesis order. *(since 1.2.5)*

## BayesPosterior

`struct BayesPosterior` — A labeled posterior distribution returned from multi-hypothesis Bayes. *(since 1.2.5)*

Conforms to: Codable, Equatable.

- `let hypotheses: [String]` — The hypothesis labels, in the same order as `probabilities`. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `let probabilities: [Double]` — The posterior probability of each hypothesis. Sums to `1.0`. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `func markdownTable() -> String` — Returns a Markdown table summarizing the posterior distribution. *(since 1.2.5)*
- `func csvRow() -> String` — Returns a single CSV row of probabilities, in hypothesis order. *(since 1.2.5)*
